title: week 1 homewrok
introduction:
“A Bicycle Built for Two Thousand” (2009) .  Aaron Koblin and Darren Massey

This artwork makes me feel art and technology help each other, but they also has some bad sides. At first, this artwork sounds like robots singing, but when we look clearly, we can know all part is sung by people. In this artwork, technology takes apart the voice of 2088 people and put them back together. so this process of taking apart also become art. And the very important thing is people were only told to copy the short sound at very low price, they know nothing about this artwork. So technology seems to connect people together to make art, but it also turns them into art parts that can be used anytime, and people do not know they are just parts. it quietly reduces people to disposable, unknowing components—used without awareness or consent, their humanity dissolved into anonymous material for someone else’s design.
